name: Camping Lermoos
beschreibung: Camping Lermoos is located in the municipality of Lermoos in the district of Reutte in Tirol. The site at the foot of the Zugspitze offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. The sanitary facilities are modern and accessible. A supermarket and a restaurant are available on site. Hikes and ski trips can be undertaken directly from the site. The campsite is open all year round. Pets are allowed on the site.
